latestPost.text: Starship V3 Flight 12 is GO! 🚀 The biggest, most powerful Starship ever built launched from Starbase today — 20 Starlink sats deployed, spacecraft splashed down in the Indian Ocean as planned. Not all booster engines fired on return, but the V3 era has begun. Next up: booster catch attempt. Also, SpaceX IPO is live on Nasdaq under SPCX. The future is multiplanetary.

While I very much wanted to be with my son, Don Jr., and the newest member of the Trump Family, his soon-to-be wife, Bettina, circumstances pertaining to Government, and my love for the United States of America, do not allow me to do so. Congratulations to Don and Bettina!

Glad to welcome President Nikos Christodoulides of Cyprus for a State Visit to India. Our bilateral talks today covered defence, trade, counter-terrorism, AI and maritime cooperation. Delighted that India and Cyprus have elevated our partnership to a Strategic Partnership, reflecting the growing depth of our ties.

Wanted to be transparent: we've restructured the company this week, affecting about 8,000 roles while moving 7,000 people to AI-focused teams. I don't expect more company-wide layoffs this year. These changes let us invest more aggressively in AI — it's the most transformative technology of our lifetimes and Meta needs to lead.

Today's current AI will look like flip phones compared to what's coming. At Google I/O we showed Gemini 3.5 Flash, Project Astra on new AI glasses, and agents that can handle long-running coding tasks autonomously. Engineers will work alongside teams of AI agents. The shift is steep and it's just beginning.

Thrilled to announce Microsoft's largest investment in Australia — A$25 billion to accelerate AI infrastructure, cybersecurity, and workforce training. At the Sydney AI Tour with 8,000+ attendees today, we outlined how this supports Australia's National AI Plan across compute, skills, and responsible AI.

Wishing Andrej all the best at Anthropic. He is one of the most talented people in AI and was instrumental in OpenAI's early days. Meanwhile, we're heads down on what's next — the pace of progress at OpenAI has never been faster. Excited about what we're shipping soon.

Apple Intelligence is transforming how people interact with their devices every day. More than 500 million active users are now engaging with AI features across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Privacy and intelligence, together.

India's digital public infrastructure story continues to inspire globally. UPI processed 18.4 billion transactions in April alone. The combination of Aadhaar + UPI + ONDC is creating an inclusive digital economy that other nations want to replicate.

Just published my summer reading list — 5 books that changed how I think about AI, climate, and human progress. Particularly recommend 'The Alignment Problem' for anyone wanting to understand AI safety beyond the headlines.

NVIDIA wins Best Choice awards at COMPUTEX 2026 for Vera Rubin NVL72 supercomputer, Jetson Thor robotics platform, and Alpamayo autonomous vehicle framework. CEO @JensenHuang to deliver keynote on June 1. The age of physical AI is here. #COMPUTEX2026

This government is delivering: GDP growth up, NHS waiting lists down, tax cuts for working people. I will be campaigning for Andy Burnham in Makerfield — because this election is about who delivers for communities, not Westminster games.

Today with Satya Nadella announcing Microsoft's historic A$25 billion investment in Australia — the largest tech investment in our nation's history. This will create thousands of jobs, build world-class AI infrastructure, and position Australia as a leader in the AI era.

New Zealand's economy is turning a corner. Inflation back to target, interest rates coming down, and businesses are hiring again. Staying disciplined on spending while investing in infrastructure and public services.

Dubai continues to lead in attracting global talent and investment. Our vision for the next decade: making the UAE the world's top destination for AI companies, startups, and skilled professionals. Excellence has no borders.

Italy stands ready to welcome Prime Minister Modi for productive bilateral discussions. The Italy-India corridor in technology, defence, and cultural exchange is growing stronger. Together we build a more connected world.

Diplomacy requires trust and discretion. Private exchanges between leaders should remain private. France will continue to stand firm for European sovereignty and transatlantic partnership. Meeting with EU leaders tomorrow to chart our course forward.

PM @narendramodi held bilateral talks with Cyprus President Christodoulides in New Delhi. India-Cyprus relations elevated to Strategic Partnership. MoUs signed on Counter-Terrorism JWG, Innovation & Technology, Defence Cooperation Roadmap 2026-2031, and Cybersecurity Dialogue.

Today, President Trump postponed signing the AI executive order to ensure it properly reflects the Administration's commitment to American AI leadership. Top tech CEOs including Musk, Pichai, Zuckerberg, Cook, and Altman had been invited to the signing ceremony.
RCB finish on top of the table! 💪 Incredible season by the boys. The playoffs await. Thank you Hyderabad for a great match. Onwards! 🔴⚫ #PlayBold #IPL2026
Tough season for MI but grateful for every fan who showed up. Looking forward to representing India in the upcoming series. The hunger never dies. 🇮🇳

Missing the entire IPL season has been the hardest part. Calf and thumb injuries kept me out for the first time in 19 years. Thank you to every CSK fan who stood by the team. The yellow will always rise. 💛

Focused on recovery and getting my body right. The Afghanistan series rest is about long-term preparation — eyes on what's ahead. Trust the process. MI still has games to fight for! 💙🏏 #MumbaiIndians #IPL2026

Not the season we wanted. MI finishes 9th — the results speak and we take full responsibility. But this team has fight, and we'll come back stronger. Thank you to every MI fan who never stopped believing. 💙

Javelin training camp in Turku going well. Working on technique refinements with coach Klaus ahead of the Diamond League season. Every millimeter matters at this level. 🇮🇳
Back to intense training for the upcoming BWF World Tour events. The Paris experience taught me so much about resilience. Ready to give my best in every tournament ahead. 🏸💪
Tennis is a lifelong journey. Spending time coaching young Indian players and seeing their passion reminds me why I fell in love with this sport. The next generation is ready. 🎾🇮🇳
Preparing for the Candidates tournament with full focus. Every game is a lesson, every position a puzzle. Chess teaches you patience above all else. ♟️
Indian football is growing every day. Proud to see the U-23 team's fighting spirit in recent matches. The dream of seeing India at the World Cup lives on. ⚽🇮🇳

American excellence requires the best talent, period. The debate around skilled immigration isn't about left vs right — it's about whether we want to win the AI race or lose it to China. Merit-based immigration strengthens America.

IBM's AI and hybrid cloud strategy continues to deliver. Watsonx enterprise deployments grew 3x this quarter. The enterprise AI market is accelerating faster than anyone predicted — and we're just getting started.
Adobe's Firefly has generated over 15 billion images since launch. Creative AI is not replacing artists — it's amplifying human creativity at scale. Exciting times for the creative economy.
Building at the intersection of AI and consumer products. The next wave of AI-native apps won't just be chatbots — they'll be experiences that understand context deeply. Excited about what's ahead.

Chanel's commitment to craftsmanship meets innovation. Launching our first AI-assisted design tools while preserving the artisan traditions that make luxury meaningful. Technology should serve creativity, not replace it.

FedEx is leveraging AI across our global network — from route optimization to predictive delivery windows. Every package tells a story of commerce connecting people. Logistics is the backbone of the global economy.

Britain's AI sector is creating real jobs and real growth. Today announced £3 billion in new AI investment commitments from UK-based companies. This is what a pro-growth, pro-innovation approach delivers.

latestPost.text: Proud to represent the United States at the Global Legal AI Summit in Geneva. Technology is transforming access to justice worldwide. Honored to share America's perspective on AI governance and the rule of law.

Code is free speech. Honored to speak at Bitcoin 2026 in Las Vegas alongside AG Todd Blanche about defending developer rights, open-source software, and digital asset innovation. The FBI stands with lawful innovation.

latestPost.text: The future of AI policy in Washington is about enabling American innovation while ensuring safety. Working across the aisle to build frameworks that keep the US at the frontier. Productive meetings this week.

Met with communities across my constituency today. The message is clear — people want secure borders, lower immigration, and a government that listens. I will keep fighting for the values that matter to working families in Britain.

The World Bank Group is deploying $120 billion this fiscal year — a record. Climate finance, digital infrastructure, and food security remain our priorities. Development must reach the people who need it most.

What a competitive IPL 2026 season! The quality of cricket this year has been extraordinary. Four teams battling for one playoff spot — this is what makes the IPL special. Best wishes to all teams in the playoffs! 🏏
IPL continues to showcase the depth of Indian cricket. Young players stepping up when it matters most. The future of Indian cricket is incredibly bright. 🏏🇮🇳

Announced the 'Smart Border' initiative — advanced technology including drones, cameras and sensors to secure India's 6,000 km border from infiltration. Under PM @narendramodi's leadership, we will leave no stone unturned to protect our borders and our people.

The people of India deserve answers. While the government celebrates GDP numbers, everyday families are crushed by rising prices and unemployment. In Parliament today, I raised the issue of agrarian distress across 5 states. Congress stands with every farmer, every worker, every family struggling to make ends meet. 🇮🇳

उत्तर प्रदेश में GBC 5.0 के तहत निवेश विस्तार की समीक्षा की। ₹7 लाख करोड़ के तैयार प्रस्ताव, भूमि बैंक विस्तार, और FDI त्वरण पर चर्चा। यूपी को 8-ज़ोन प्रदर्शनी के माध्यम से रक्षा, हरित ऊर्जा और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स में आत्मनिर्भर बनाएंगे।

Delhi needs honest governance, not PR. AAP will continue to fight for free electricity, quality education, and world-class healthcare for every Delhiite. The people's movement cannot be stopped by any force.

Productive discussions between PM @narendramodi and Cyprus President @Aborislow on elevating India-Cyprus ties to a Strategic Partnership. Key agreements on counter-terrorism, defence, innovation and maritime cooperation will deepen our engagement. A new chapter in bilateral relations.

India's fiscal consolidation continues on track. GST collections for April crossed ₹2.37 lakh crore — a new record. The economy is growing at 7.2%, inflation is under control, and our external position remains strong.

President Murmu received Cyprus President Nikos Christodoulides at Rashtrapati Bhavan for the ceremonial welcome. India and Cyprus share deep civilizational bonds and a shared commitment to democracy, maritime security, and counter-terrorism cooperation.

Adani Group's green energy portfolio crosses 15 GW operational capacity. Our commitment: 45 GW renewable energy by 2030. India's energy transition is not just about sustainability — it's about energy security and economic growth for 1.4 billion people.

Reliance expands into power and telecommunications as the family noncompete agreement concludes. Jio's AI-first platform is already serving 480 million subscribers. India's digital future is being built today.

Ratan Tata Foundation continues its mission of transforming healthcare and education access across rural India. Announcing 50 new primary health centres in partnership with state governments. Progress happens one community at a time.
